_comment: The benign roles of jailbreak/requests/benign_role.py: twelve plain roles per style, each put before the prompt, as real users open a request: a helper who knows the subject (subject_helper), a tutor or coach (tutor), an assistant for a named everyday task (task_assistant). Ordinary and harmless by design: no role asks the assistant to set anything aside or says how to reply. Drawn for benign and dual-use benign inputs only.

subject_helper.name: field_expert

{prompt}
